fields.sample_size: document-based mapping of Brazil's sanitation service chain against all 169 SDG targets (UN, national data; 86.1% of Brazil's population has at least basic sanitation); no respondent sample
fields.effect_estimate: 87 SDG targets across 16 goals require action in Brazil's sanitation sector and 124 targets show synergies with sanitation in four domains (basic services for resilience building, equity and empowerment, pollution reduction and waste reuse, economic well-being); policy recommendations include closed-loop systems and policy coherence across sectors. Conceptual target mapping; no effect estimates and little on legal measures.
fields.study_design: systematic conceptual target-mapping case study (one country)
fields.section: Full text: Introduction; Methods (sanitation service chain, SDG target coding); Results (targets by goal); Discussion
fields.exact_location: Introduction; Methods (sanitation service chain, SDG target coding); Results (targets by goal); Discussion

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a systematic mapping of Brazil's sanitation sector to the 169 SDG targets, read in full text 2026-10-04. 87 targets in 16 goals require sanitation action and 124 show synergies. Conceptual; no outcome data and limited legal content (cf. A12).
pdf_note: Journal article (2021), about 81,000 characters read; manuscript with line numbers
notes: Abstract-level extraction accurate. Scope question: SDG mapping with little legal or administrative exposure.
